verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs state it runs on Linux, macOS and Windows 10, and the GitHub repo describes it as cross-platform. It uses one Lua config file (`.wezterm.lua`), with a portable-config option next to `wezterm.exe` on Windows. Community users report keeping a single config, or sharing large parts of it, across Linux, macOS and Windows/WSL. Some users note per-OS performance differences (macOS rendering and latency, Windows input latency) and that only 'large parts' of the config carry over. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing one config working identically on all three OSes (e.g., guidance for OS-conditional settings), and evidence of consistent behavior on every platform.
